status: accepted_scoring_design; source-only annotation review and corpus freeze pending
estimand: Reviewer-assessed preservation of predeclared critical source evidence on selected notice units; not automated field-extractor precision or national accuracy.
evaluation_unit: notice unit; all arm comparisons paired by fixture_id and input_sha256

corpus_constraints.quota_shortfall_policy: Record and freeze any unmet quota; never fill or replace using vendor performance.

reference_rules.criticality: Freeze before vendor outputs; critical when loss/wrong association can change notice identity/lifecycle, participation opportunity, date role/precision, deadline condition, eligibility or withdrawal scope. Do not make agency/contact/lexical trivia critical merely to meet a quota.
reference_rules.independent_questions_means: Nonduplicate semantic questions, not statistically independent observations.
reference_rules.field_grouping: Keep value/date/time/zone facets of one date role in one compound field when practicable; otherwise assign the same semantic_group_id and show group counts. Repeated mentions are evidence for one field, not extra successes.
reference_rules.absence_scope: Specify all relevant input pages/columns/sections plus boundaries. not_stated means not in retained notice scope, not absent from full proceeding/package.
reference_rules.reference_changes_after_freeze: Retain initial and amended versions, reason and hashes; no silent editing. A source-only correction must be applied symmetrically to every arm, with initial/adjudicated results separated if any output was already viewed.
reference_rules.supplement_ownership: Reviewer-owned adjudicated reference files only; collector fixture.json schema unchanged. Preserve collector originals and hashes, then add reviewer supplements and adjudications alongside them.

outcome_definitions.supported: Output preserves the expected value and decisive role/mark/scope relation, including relevant precision/conditions; exact retained output evidence exists. Correct words alone do not suffice.
outcome_definitions.partial_ambiguous: Some relevant source evidence survives, but decisive role, scope, mark association, condition or precision is unresolved. Correct answer reconstructed by reviewer does not upgrade it.
outcome_definitions.missing: Required evidence is omitted on a completed parse, including absent-field scope lost or not preserved.
outcome_definitions.incorrect: Output positively contradicts source value/role/selection/scope or invents unsupported critical information. Distinguish transcription error, role/association error and unsupported assertion subtypes.
outcome_definitions.safe_abstention: Explicit abstention or correctly preserved blank/unselected state. For not_stated references, full relevant scope must survive. For a determinate present/explicit_negative answer, an abstention is a safe miss and cannot pass its evidence gate.
outcome_definitions.not_assessable: Reference uncertainty, operational failure/no result, provider-stop nonattempt, or inaccessible output. reason_code required; never a successful abstention.

additional_requirements: No contradictory rendition elsewhere in the same notice scope.
For visual selection: preserved state attached to correct option group and section/column; both incompatible checked states fail.
For temporal claims: exact role and stated precision retained; no inferred zone, anchor or absolute deadline.
field_gate_rules.ambiguous_blank_reference: Adjudicate explicit_negative versus not_stated before output review. A checked not-scheduled option is explicit_negative; a blank effective-date option is not_stated.

document_gate.strict_gate_label: strict predeclared critical-evidence gate, not complete-document accuracy
document_gate.primary_recommended_reference_eligibilit: Accepted strict-reference policy: at least four determinate, nonduplicate critical questions and no unresolved critical reference questions for an unqualified strict pass. Retain units with insufficient reference coverage in the all-scheduled corpus denominator; report restricted-scope results separately.
document_gate.low_reference_coverage_policy: Do not fabricate a fourth question. Retain the selected unit, report insufficient_reference separately, and optionally show restricted-scope results; it cannot inflate strict passes.
document_gate.formula: PASS iff reference gate eligible AND completed nonempty parse output AND every eligible critical field passes its answerability-specific gate AND no critical incorrect assertion found in the notice-wide extra-assertion audit.
denominators: All frozen selected notice units for overall paired gate table.
Reference-eligible notice units as an explicitly secondary denominator, identical across arms.
document_gate.uncertain_reference_policy: List uncertain fields separately; no vacuous all-fields pass. If any critical reference remains uncertain, this strict gate is insufficient_reference; show determinate-field diagnostics separately.

extra_assertion_audit.scope: Bounded sweep of the complete retained notice output for added/contradictory participation dates, lifecycle/withdrawal scope, temporal anchors, and checked/unchecked selections. Include critical facts outside the 6-10 reference questions.
extra_assertion_audit.not_an_assertion: Merely reproducing visibly unselected form labels is not a false assertion. Lost states may be ambiguous; label them as such.
extra_assertion_audit.deduplication: Count one underlying wrong assertion once even when it fails multiple related fields; additionally report documents with >=1 critical incorrect assertion.
extra_assertion_audit.precision_claim_prohibited: No extracted-assertion precision unless a separately defined exhaustive extraction mechanism and denominator are actually run.

operation_policy.content_coverage: A successful HTTP/MCP call is not full evidence coverage; missing regions in returned text remain content errors.
operation_policy.timeout: No field-quality score; output fields not_assessable with operational reason; document operational_unusable; billing unknown unless reported.
operation_policy.stop_censoring: Nonattempts after provider stop are separate from attempted failures, but stay in scheduled paired notice denominators.
operation_policy.pair_scheduling: Freeze a corpus order and arm/version settings; use the same fixture order where practicable so provider-stop effects are visible rather than performance-driven.
operation_policy.provider_stop_definition: Consecutive operational failures counted by completion order per provider; both Llama tiers share the Llama provider counter. A success resets its failure streak. After the third consecutive failure, submit no new calls. Retain outcomes of at most two already in flight; do not silently retry timed-out jobs.

metrics.headline: Paired document-gate outcomes over all frozen units, plus all-scheduled critical positive evidence yield with operational failures/nonattempts separately counted.
metrics.positive_critical_recovery: Use the explicitly named evidence_yield and successful_output_content_score metrics; never present an unlabeled denominator.
metrics.negative_scope_preservation: Among completed nonempty output: safe_abstention critical not_stated fields with full scope divided by eligible critical not_stated references. Exclude service failures and uncertain references; never pool with positive recovery without showing both components.
metrics.conditional_content_diagnostic: Same category counts restricted to successful nonempty output, with its distinct denominator plainly labeled.
metrics.field_yield_warning: Field totals are descriptive only; correlated within notice/template and not binomial trials.
metrics.paired_gain_loss: For each fixed pair of arms, display both-pass / left-only-pass / right-only-pass / both-content-fail / one-or-both-operationally-unusable / reference-insufficient. For usable pairs also show corrected versus newly incorrect critical fields without inferring significance.
metrics.stratum_rules: State and primary bucket are mutually exclusive allocation strata; layout features may overlap and must not be summed as independent totals. Always include notice denominators and reference critical-group counts.
metrics.clustering: Retain original_pdf_id/hash, register_issue_id, template_family_id and agency; show distinct counts and repeat-template results. Units/pages/fields from one original are not independent evidence of breadth.
metrics.statistics: Counts and paired tables; no national confidence intervals, p-values or pseudo-precise cross-state accuracy inference from purposive n=20.
metrics.timing: Successful-call median, min/max, count and input pages; failures/timeouts and nonattempts shown separately. State whether upload included. No inference from one call/unit.
metrics.cost: Actual returned usage only; unknown stays unknown. Published prices separate, units vendor-specific; timed-out backend charges unknown. Unique input page cap is not total billable pages.
metrics.evidence_yield: Supported determinate critical present/explicit_negative fields divided by all such reference fields scheduled for that arm. Operationally unusable/nonattempted items contribute no recovered evidence and remain separately identified; uncertain references excluded. This is operationally inclusive evidence yield, never automated extraction accuracy.
metrics.successful_output_content_score: Among completed nonempty outputs, supported critical present/explicit_negative fields divided by determinate eligible critical present/explicit_negative reference fields. Operational failures/nonattempts excluded from this conditional denominator and reported separately; uncertain references excluded.

blinding: Prefer neutral arm codes during evidence scoring if feasible; do not claim blinded review when output format reveals provider. Freeze references before viewing any vendor parse output.
readiness_gates: All input/source hashes and physical page maps checked.
All source-reference questions independently reviewed against every relevant rendered input page.
All conflicts adjudicated or explicitly uncertain, with collector versions retained.
Scoring ambiguities accepted or amended by primary before freeze.
forbidden_claims: Automated extractor precision from reviewer interpretation
General vendor winner based on this corpus
Actual billing inferred from published price or timeout
accepted_protocol_clarifications: Safe abstention on a visibly present field is a safe miss, not gate success.
Extra critical assertions outside selected reference fields are retained and fail the strict gate.
Operational failures and uncertain references excluded from conditional field-quality denominator; operational/document denominators remain explicit.

primary_acceptance.source: primary task delegation in this reviewer chat
clarifications: All-scheduled positive-field ratio is evidence yield, not accuracy; operationally unusable included as unrecovered with separate counts.
Successful-output content scores use their own denominator; neither metric is automated extraction accuracy.
Provider stop counts failure completions across both Llama tiers; at most two already in flight.
Reference supplements belong in reviewer adjudicated files; do not add collector requirements midstream.
Parent freezes only after complete source-only review.

remaining_readiness_work: Independently inspect all source annotations and all relevant rendered pages for A01-A10 and B01-B10.
Record reviewer-only supplements, disagreements and adjudicated references; no new vendor outputs read.
Check corpus quotas, page budget, duplicate/template/issue counts and full-scope absence evidence.
Parent saves immutable corpus/reference/contract freeze after source review.
